info.title: WebPilot
info.description: Read and summarize a web page URL directly provided by the user. Do not use this tool for general web search or when the user has not provided an exact URL.

post.summary: Read a directly provided web page URL.

link.description: The exact web page URL provided by the user. Do not invent or guess a URL.

ur.description: The user's reading or summarization instruction for the provided URL.

lp.description: Must be true because this tool should only be used for links directly provided by the user.

rt.description: Set true when retrying because the previous result did not meet the user's need.

l.description: The response language, such as zh-CN or en.
